standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: You lied to me human. While that was a mighty fine banana, it was not the best banana in the world!

standard-dialogue.player: And how would you know? Have you tried every banana in the world?

standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: Well, no... I suppose not, but I've had better. On Ape Atoll there is a tree which grows red bananas. They are the best!
If the player has freed King Awowogei subquest.

steps.player: Ah, of course. I almost forgot about those. I once had to prepare a stuffed snake using those bananas for King Awowogei.

steps.speaker: Monkey
steps.text: Wait? You've worked for our great ruler? I didn't realise we had started employing human chefs. Bring me a banana sandwich immediately!

standard-dialogue.text: If the player has not freed King Awowogei subquest.

steps.player: Red bananas? Surely you're pulling my leg? There's no such thing.

steps.speaker: Monkey
steps.text: What? I'm in this cage. I can't pull your leg.

using-unicorn-s-caged-monkey-on-an-affec.text: There is already a monkey in that cage!
